# Hand-marked Roman numerals in Bach, Minuet in G, BWV Anh. 114 (Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach, 1725).
#
# SOURCE: the Minuet in G major as engraved in the Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach, 1725 (Neue Bach-Ausgabe
# V/4; the IMSLP scan of the Notebook). The score text itself was not available when this file was written.
# STATUS: DRAFT, NOT YET CHECKED AGAINST THE PRINTED SCORE. The marks are a hand reading of the harmony, made
# from the pitch content of tests/fixtures/framework-v1-corpus/"Bach 114.mid" (dumped note by note, measure by
# measure) and the Minuet's known harmonic outline. They were NOT derived from the output of the chord
# identifier, the key estimator or this adapter. A human should confirm them against an edition before this
# file is relied on. Where the second strain's A chords (measures 18-19) tonicize D, they are marked as applied
# chords in G (V/V), the reading of the piece's own key; a key estimator that reads measures 17-20 as D major
# will disagree, and that is a result to report, not a mark to change.
#
# METER: the score is 3/4. (The MIDI file declares 4/4, which is wrong for the piece; the evaluation test uses
# a 3/4 MeterMap.) The file plays the repeats out: measures 1-8 are the first strain, 9-16 the same again,
# 17-24 the second strain, 25-32 the same again. Only the first playing of each strain (measures 1-8 and
# 17-24) is marked: the repeats are note for note the same.
#
# FORMAT: one chord per line, the chord that starts at the mark and sounds until the next one:
#   <measure> <beat> <numeral>
# Measure counts from 1. Beat is 1-based in quarter-note beats (a half beat is written .5: 2.5 is the second
# half of beat 2). The numeral is in the LOCAL key, which is G major throughout, spelled in ASCII:
#   upper/lower case Roman numeral, "o" after it for a diminished chord, then the bass figure: none for root
#   position, 6, 6/4; for a seventh chord 7, 6/5, 4/3, 4/2. An applied chord is the numeral, its figure, a
#   slash and the numeral of the chord it tonicizes: V/V, V6/V, V4/3/V. Lines starting with # and blank lines
#   are ignored. A final line "END" marks the end of a marked stretch (the scope below it ends there).
#
# SCOPE: measures 1-8 (the first strain) and 17-24 (the second strain).
